note: Buddha preached in Pali, the language of the masses (NIOS Lesson 5, p. 66: 'Buddha used Pali language spoken by masses to propagate his teachings'; IGNOU BHIC-101 Unit 12, p. 214, gives the same point with the Sanskrit contrast). Taught in buddha_teaching and practised as q15.

Dipavamsa as a Buddhist chronicle (genealogical/regional history text), not a Pitaka: NCERT Themes I Theme 4, p. 86 — Dipavamsa and Mahavamsa written in Sri Lanka containing regional histories of Buddhism, while the three Pitakas are listed separately. Taught in sangha_texts (with a dont_confuse box) and practised as q24.

Cause of all sorrow = Trishna (desire): IGNOU Unit 12, p. 212, Four Noble Truths — 'desire, ignorance and attachment are the causes of sufferings'. Taught in buddha_teaching (with an exam_note box) and practised as q14.
